name: code-shader-dissolve
title: Code Shader Dissolve
description: A code snippet appears through a noise dissolve: a glowing cyan edge with a small colour fringe sweeps over the card as the syntax-highlighted lines resolve, then the card holds crisp. WebGL shader over a card the block draws from a code variable.
useWhen: A code snippet that should materialise rather than just appear: developer tools, API and tutorial videos.
A reveal where the card should keep the exact syntax colours once it settles.
avoidWhen: The code must be readable from the first frame.
Very long snippets: the card is fitted to the frame, so long code gets small.
author: HeyGen (Hyperframes)

variables.label: Code
variables.description: The snippet shown. Use line breaks; JavaScript-like syntax is highlighted with a GitHub-dark palette.

variables.label: Resolution
variables.description: Share of the frame size the shader is drawn at, then scaled up. Code text needs 0.75.
